title.zh: Epic与迪士尼射击游戏延期：禁止手写代码，美术也全面转向AI
title.en: Epic与迪士尼射击游戏延期：禁止手写代码，美术也全面转向AI

current_state.zh: Epic Games and Disney's co-developed Marvel/Star Wars shooter has been delayed indefinitely while Epic confirms a company-wide shift to an 'AI first' workflow where code is generated by AI tools such as Claude and art is produced via AI pipelines with human oversight.
current_state.en: Epic Games and Disney's co-developed Marvel/Star Wars shooter has been delayed indefinitely while Epic confirms a company-wide shift to an 'AI first' workflow where code is generated by AI tools such as Claude and art is produced via AI pipelines with human oversight.
